name: Sabela, Gossamer Penance's WARRIOR Class Bonus On Enter recurs a banished Sword regalia
notes: Seeds a WARRIOR/CRUX champion for the Class Bonus and element access, and a Sword regalia in the banishment, then plays Sabela and confirms her On Enter ability returns the regalia to the field with a bond counter. Does not cover the On Leave sacrifice trigger, which requires removing Sabela from the field.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Enter: Choose a Sword regalia card with memory cost 1 or less from your banishment and put it onto the field. Put a bond counter on it.
